reproductionMatrix.expected: teaching spacing: one readable target/decision at a time
checks: next actionable object enters view before irreversible window

reproductionMatrix.expected: moving-support spacing with a recoverable observation window
checks: moving object does not overlap target and hazard without causal choice

reproductionMatrix.expected: dense chain spacing only after teaching, with clear cut order
checks: chain density escalates by authored beat
hard objects do not mask cuttable silhouettes

reproductionMatrix.expected: structure/finish synthesis with separated risk choices
checks: falling fragments do not create accidental visual pileups
finish lanes and hazards retain distinct silhouettes

rootCauseHypothesis: The factory validates object existence, collision, and level completion, but has no all-level projected-spacing/occlusion gate; the previous review incorrectly narrowed scope to levels containing moving objects.
acceptanceCriteria: Every level 01-12 receives a spacing and occlusion report for desktop and both mobile orientations.
Every gameplay object is classified as target, hazard, support, recovery, structure, or decoration with no ambiguous visual overlap.
Dense beats are preceded by a teach/read beat and preserve a visible next-action window.
Any level failing spacing, occlusion, or causal readability remains BLOCKED and routes to Blueprint/Builder before release.
